name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to carry the key while the ball is out of the way of the door, not just to pick up the target box. Add a clause for blocker_moved and a clause for has_door_key to record this requirement. With the existing Existence clause, the agent could pick up the target box immediately, as soon as the ball is out of the way, without carrying the key. This is not what the task asks for. Use Existence for the key and Precedence to express the requirement that the key is carried while the ball is out of the way.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task states a condition, not a rule, so Precedence is not the right template. The task requires the key to be carried only when the blocker is moved, not before. Use Existence instead, with the correct order and priority: hard Existence(blocker_moved) and soft Existence(has_door_key) when blocker_moved is true.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the key to be acquired before the door is opened, but no clause makes it happen. Add a hard Existence(has_door_key); keep the hard Existence(blocker_moved) and Existence(target_picked_up).
